sections.text: Together through it all
In the midst of life’s challenges, especially when confronted with a cancer diagnosis, understanding and accessing your welfare benefits should be the least of your worries.

We provide free, clear, and comprehensive welfare benefits advice specifically for those who have been diagnosed with cancer. Our expertise ensures that during these trying times, you’re equipped with the information and support needed to navigate financial welfare, allowing you to focus on recovery and wellbeing.
We can advise on:
Discover which benefits and tax credits you’re entitled to, and get expert guidance on the application process.

image.alt: hand and a heart icon on orange circle
image.caption: charitable grants 135 x 135

sections.text: Access crucial funding support from charities to ease the financial burden during your health journey.

image.alt: a plus sign on orange circle
image.caption: Healthcare travel expenses 135 x 135

sections.text: Cover unforeseen health-related costs, especially those associated with hospital visits and treatments.

image.alt: coins and a piece of paper on orange circle
image.caption: Household budgeting 135 x 135

sections.text: Navigate and manage household and fuel expenses effectively, ensuring you’re making the most of available resources.

image.alt: bus and car icons on orange circle
image.caption: Transport privileges 135 x 135

sections.text: Understand and apply for transportation concessions, including acquiring a disabled parking badge for ease of mobility.
We can help with debt, eomployment or housing issues that or signpost you to specialist advisors if required.
Who we can help
We offer financial guidance to specific boroughs and hospitals. We’re here to help those in our focus areas manage the financial challenges of cancer.
Residents of Key Boroughs
If you’re located in Tower Hamlets, Newham, Hackney, or the City of London, our services are tailored just for you.
Patients at Major Hospitals

If you’re receiving treatment as an inpatient or outpatient at St Bartholomew’s Hospital, The Royal London Hospital, Homerton University Hospital, Newham University Hospital, or Whipps Cross University Hospital, we’re poised to assist. If you require support but do not fit this criteria, please visit the Macmillan Cancer Support site for additional resources and assistance.

sections.text: How to access our advice
Get advice that fits around you. We can help…
While receiving care in our partner hospitals, just speak to a nurse or doctor and ask for the Macmillan benefits team. We’re here to assist you during your hospital stay.

image.alt: mobile phone icon on blue circle
image.caption: by phone 135 x 135

sections.text: Give us a call on freephone 020 7392 2958, or use our form to request a callback. Our lines are open Monday to Thursday, 12:30pm – 3:30pm.

image.alt: web chat icon on blue circle
image.caption: Video and webchat 135 x 135

sections.text: If you wish to contact us by email, please email macmillan.advice@toynbeehall.org.uk.
